message.content:
This editorial illustration for the magazine cover of TEMPO, dated 16-22 DESEMBER 2013, features a tan-colored background with red borders. The word "TEMPO" is printed in large red capital letters across the top. Below the masthead, black text reads "SIAPA BEKING ASIAN AGRI". 

The central illustration depicts a large, red mechanical pencil sharpener positioned horizontally. A yellow pencil with the logo and green text "ASIAN AGRI" is inserted into the sharpener’s hole. Emerging from the sharpener's blade area, instead of wooden shavings, is a long, continuous roll of white paper that resembles a thermal receipt. This paper roll curls and piles up toward the right side of the frame. Printed on the portion of the paper immediately exiting the sharpener is a black-and-white portrait of a man in a suit, shown from the chest up and smiling. The paper roll contains faded, illegible columns of printed characters. At the bottom left, the price "RP 33.000", website "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and a barcode with the numbers "9 770126 427302" are visible. Other headlines appear at the very top.
